{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Xaczik''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. It was one of rarer Wookiee languages with the primary one being [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]]. It was mainly spoken on the [[Wartaki Islands/Legends|Wartaki Islands]] and in other coastal regions.

While the Wookiees were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Wookiee resistance used Xaczik as a secret language to pass messages along. Since the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of the Empire thought all Wookiees were alike, they never realized that the Wookiees spoke languages other than Shyriiwook. Thanks to Imperial ignorance, Xaczik became an unbreakable code.<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref><ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

It was also used during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] at [[Council Rock]] during the meeting there.<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[The Star Wars 6|''The Star Wars'' 6]], ''xaczhick'' is used as a word in the Wookiee language.
